verdict.rationale: Cross-workspace search applies to a work-management product like monday.com, but nothing in the evidence pack documents searching across tasks, docs, and comments, or the speed and accuracy of results. Community complaints about general interface slowness are not about search, so they are not used here. The listed items cover agents, integrations, APIs, and app hosting.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results
